quote: We use four metrics to evaluate detector effectiveness: (1) Macro-F1: Measures balance between misalignment detection and usability. (2) Total Detection Errors (TDE): Sum of false negatives (undetected misalignment) and positives (false alarms) as an approximation of real-world impact. (3) Effective Reliability (ER): T P -F P T P +F P , where TP represents true positives and FP represents false positives, respectively. This metric measures the reliability of the detected misaligned actions, i.e., how many more true positives there are compared to false positives. (4) PR-AUC: Captures performance across thresholds, offering a threshold-independent view.

Direct Prompt. This approach represents the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm, where the model is directly prompted to judge the correctness of a trajectory. This is commonly used to assess behavior in LLM-based agents due to its simplicity and interpretability. This method directly queries LLMs to classify trajectories as Correct/Incorrect, prompting alerts on Incorrect.
